Population increased in Charnwood

The estimated population of Charnwood in 2024 was 188,385 usual residents, a rise of 0.6% since 2023.

This meant that Charnwood's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Charnwood increased by 3%.

Over this slightly longer period, Charnwood was also among the areas that had a broadly average population increase, of local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Charnwood

The average (median) age rose to 39.8 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Charnwood has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Charnwood is an area that is classed as intermediate urban in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Charnwood's population of 188,385 usual residents was made up of:

  • 31,605 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16.8%)
  • 120,197 people aged 16 to 64 years, (63.8%)
  • 36,583 people aged 65 years and over, (19.4%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Charnwood has a slightly lower proportion of people aged 0 to 15 years (16.8% compared with 18.3% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Charnwood, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net international migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Charnwood
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Charnwood, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 152 people (-0.1%). In total, there were 1,579 births and 1,731 deaths in Charnwood.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) led to a fall in the population of 60 (0%). There were 16,263 people entering the area and 16,323 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Charnwood's population of 1,422 (0.8%) as a result of 3,078 people entering the area and 1,656 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Charnwood was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Charnwood in mid-2023 is 187,179.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 360 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 1,191 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 831 people.
